note: Book misprint: the spell list prints 'Burst'. No spell of that name exists in any SR6 book or CommLink6; the list is alphabetical and Burst sits between Animate Plastic and Chaos, where only Blast (CRB p.140, Clout's area version) fits. Read as Blast (owner ruling 2026-10-19).

Book pricing: the gear line prints 'earbuds (rating 4; w/audio enhancement, audio link, select sound filter 2)', but the book priced the audio enhancement (4,000¥) and the select sound filter 2 (2 x 3,500¥ = 7,000¥) as standalone earware augmentations (CRB p.287 earware table, 0.1 Essence each), not as earbud accessories (the gear accessories cost 500¥ and 2 x 250¥). This is the only reading that matches the book: it accounts for the printed Essence 3.3, 0.2 below the 3.5 the listed augmentations leave, exactly, and for the nuyen gap of about 10,320¥ to within about 320¥, while cyberears rating 4 (about 18,300¥, 0.4 Essence) or rating 2 (about 13,800¥) overshoot both. So the earbuds keep audio link, and audio enhancement and select sound filter 2 are bought as augmentations (owner ruling 2026-10-19).

edits.from: earbuds (rating 4; w/audio enhancement, audio link, select sound filter 2)

note: Book error (review: leftover.karma): as printed the build leaves 8 Karma, past the 5 that carry over (CRB Hong Kong p.66). The best priority assignment (B/A/C/D/E, 9 Karma turned into nuyen, 1,640¥ left; the book prints 470¥) leaves 8, no Sum-to-Ten assignment (SWC p.27) leaves less, and turning 3 more Karma into nuyen would leave more than the 5,000¥ that carry over (CRB Hong Kong p.68). The printed purchases are priced as the book's tables print them, so the extra Karma is the book's, per the owner's standing rulings (2026-10-21: the book's own error is annotated, never corrected silently).

Book error (review: catalog.capacity): the cyberarm is printed with Agility 5, Strength 10, holster, arm slide, retractable spur and small smugglers compartment. An obvious cyberarm has Capacity 15 (CRB p.288); what it is printed with takes 21: holster [5], slide [3], retractable spurs [3], smuggling compartment [5] (no small one is printed, CRB p.290), Agility +2 [2] and Strength +3 [3]. Kept as printed, per the owner's standing rulings (2026-10-21: the book's own error is annotated, never corrected silently).
